summary: @onereach/si-code preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from oven-sh/bun GitHub release archives into a temporary directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that uses hex-named identifiers and a shuffled string-array decoder (`WV8StW` array-rotation function). The install script `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style transformations (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, per-call scrambled string maps). The package is published as a Vue UI/validation helper (vuelidate/joi component), a purpose that has no need for a second language runtime or an opaque compiled bundle. Fetching an alien runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling payload at install time causes arbitrary code from `math_init.js` to run on the installer's machine under Bun, bypassing Node-focused install-time inspection. The actual behavior of the payload is not observable without executing it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
